A1.justification: Both PDFs are complete, readable 28-page versions of the same LocoGS research work. The main text, Appendix A, equations, algorithms, Tables 1-14 and Figures 1-15 can be matched reliably despite layout shifts.

before.justification: v1 reports original LocoGS benchmark evaluations, component ablations, rendering and decoding measurements, and large-scale scene experiments in Section 6 and Appendix A.

after.justification: v2 retains original experimental results in Section 6 and Appendix A, including quantitative comparisons, ablations and qualitative rendering examples.

M1.justification: Sections 4-5 and Algorithms 1-4 retain the same explicit/implicit attribute decomposition, hash-grid representation, dense initialization, Gaussian pruning, adaptive SH bandwidth, losses and compression procedures. No method component or algorithm step changes.

E1.justification: Both evaluate the same nine Mip-NeRF 360 scenes, two Tanks and Temples scenes and two Deep Blending scenes. The Building and Rubble scenes from Mill-19 already appear in v1's Appendix A.5.3 and remain in v2; no dataset or test scenario is added.

E2.justification: The corresponding comparisons retain 3DGS, Scaffold-GS, CompGS, Compact-3DGS, C3DGS, LightGaussian, EAGLES, SSGS and HAC. The dense-initialization variants in Table 6 and the Mill-19 comparison against 3DGS also retain their comparator membership.

E3.justification: Section 6 and Appendix A.1 preserve the training budgets, model configurations, image-resolution settings, evaluation metrics and timing procedures. Both specify 30K optimization iterations and a 5K warm-up stage; no existing protocol is revised or new protocol introduced.

E4.justification: The pipeline ablation and studies of attribute selection, voxelization, hash-grid size, dense initialization and SH bandwidth are retained. Appendix analyses of Gaussian counts, decoding time and large-scale behavior also remain unchanged; relocated displays do not introduce new analyses.

E5.justification: Both versions report dataset averages and average timing over 100 renderings of each test image in Appendix A.1. Neither adds or changes seed information, training-run variability, confidence intervals or significance testing.

E6.justification: The numerical tables and qualitative results are unchanged throughout the main text and appendix. For example, Table 1 reports the same LocoGS result in both versions: 27.33 PSNR, 0.814 SSIM, 0.219 LPIPS, 13.89 MB and 270 FPS. Mill-19 and per-scene results are also retained.

T1.justification: Equations 1-14 retain the same Gaussian and SH definitions, optimization losses, dense-initialization mathematics and G-PCC transformation. No mathematical assumption, derivation, theorem or proof is added, removed or corrected.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same locality-aware compression contributions and performance claims, including 54.6-96.6 times storage compression and 2.1-2.4 times rendering speed relative to 3DGS. Their scientific meaning and scope are unchanged.

C2.justification: The explanations based on local coherence, dense geometric priors and SH regularization remain unchanged. Section 7 and Appendix A.5.3 retain the limitations concerning training time, training memory, object-centric hash-grid assumptions and large-scale scenes.

D1.justification: v2 adds a project-page URL beneath the author affiliations. The architecture, hyperparameters, quantization, hardware and implementation details are otherwise retained. The added link supplies an access pointer, but the PDFs alone do not establish changed code or data availability.

R1.justification: Section 2 removes citation occurrences for Dupont et al. (2022), Reiser et al. (2023) and Tang et al. (2022) from specific background statements. These works remain cited elsewhere and the bibliography is unchanged, so this is limited citation pruning rather than revised research positioning.

P1.justification: v2 adds Section 8 funding acknowledgments, replaces the Preprint header with the ICLR 2025 publication header, makes small wording and citation-format corrections, and trims two appendix-pointer sentences. The scientific narrative and section organization remain substantially unchanged.

P2.justification: The same figures and tables are retained, with spacing and float-placement changes. For example, Figure 6 moves from page 14 to 15, Figure 7 from page 15 to 16, and Table 7 from page 17 to 18. The embedded images are unchanged; these are layout adjustments rather than new or redesigned evidence.

improvement.justification: The project-page link and acknowledgments add modest convenience and funding transparency, alongside light editorial cleanup. However, the method description, complete experimental evidence, mathematical content and substantive limitations remain unchanged. The revision does not resolve a substantive weakness or introduce a material loss, leaving overall paper quality effectively unchanged.
